nodes.short_description: Viva a derradeira experiência de velocidade em VR! Assuma o volante em Racing Fever, um simulador com carros personalizáveis, pistas profissionais e competição intensa.

nodes.long_description: Probuďte svou vášeň pro rychlost! Racing Fever vás posadí přímo do sedadla řidiče. Vlastnosti: Vlastní garáž a vylepšení, ladění výkonu, rozmanité tratě od lesů po pobřeží a pohlcující VR kokpit s interaktivníma rukama.
nodes.short_description: Zažijte dokonalou rychlost ve VR! Ovládněte plně přizpůsobitelná auta na profesionálních tratích a staňte se nejlepším závodníkem v tomto intenzivním simulátoru.

nodes.long_description: スピードへの情熱を燃やせ！最高に没入感のあるVRレース体験。特徴：カスタムガレージとアップグレード、性能チューニング、多様なコース（森林や海岸路）、そしてインタラクティブなVRコクピット。今すぐアクセルを踏み込もう！
nodes.short_description: 究極のVRスピードウェイを体験しよう！『Racing Fever』は、フルカスタマイズ可能なマシン、プロ仕様のコース、臨場感あふれる一人称視点のレースシミュレーターです。

nodes.long_description: Accendi la tua passione per la velocità! Racing Fever ti mette direttamente al posto di guida. Caratteristiche: Garage personalizzato, tuning delle prestazioni, piste varie e un cockpit VR immersivo con interni dettagliati.
nodes.short_description: Vivi l'ultima esperienza di velocità in VR! Mettiti alla guida in Racing Fever, un simulatore con auto personalizzabili, piste professionali e competizione in prima persona.

nodes.long_description: Ignite your passion for speed! Racing Fever: Car Racing Game puts you in the driver’s seat of powerful racing machines. Features: Custom garage & upgrades, performance tuning, diverse tracks, and an immersive VR cockpit view.
nodes.short_description: Experience the ultimate VR speedway! Take the wheel in Racing Fever, a high-octane racing simulator with customisable cars, professional tracks, and intense first-person competition.

nodes.long_description: 속도에 대한 열정을 깨우세요! Racing Fever는 당신을 강력한 레이싱 머신의 운전석에 앉게 합니다. 특징: 커스텀 차고 및 업그레이드, 성능 튜닝, 다양한 레이싱 트랙, 그리고 실감나는 VR 콕핏 뷰.
nodes.short_description: 최고의 VR 스피드웨이를 경험하세요! Racing Fever에서 커스터마이징 가능한 차량과 전문 트랙, 강렬한 1인칭 경쟁이 펼쳐지는 레이싱 시뮬레이터를 즐겨보세요.

nodes.long_description:
Ignite your passion for speed in the most immersive VR racing experience yet!

Racing Fever: Car Racing Game puts you directly in the driver’s seat of powerful racing machines. Whether you are a casual driver or a simulation enthusiast, this game offers the perfect balance of realistic physics and exhilarating arcade action.

Key Features:

Custom Garage & Upgrades: Personalize your vehicle in a high-tech showroom. Modify your car with custom neon lighting, spoilers, roof attachments, and unique rim designs.

Performance Tuning: Adjust your car's suspension and performance to match your driving style, ensuring you have the edge on every corner.

Diverse Racing Tracks: Compete on multiple professional circuits, including scenic forest tracks and mountainous coastal roads, each offering unique challenges and obstacles.

Immersive VR Cockpit: Feel the vibration of the engine and the tension of the steering wheel with a detailed first-person interior view and interactive VR hands.

Competitive Leaderboards: Race against AI opponents and track your standing on the "Racer List". Can you beat Alex, David, and Jack to claim the #1 spot?

Dynamic Difficulty: Choose between different driving modes, including a "Simulation" setting for those seeking a true-to-life racing challenge.

Buckle up and hit the gas—your journey to the winner's circle starts now!

The finish line is waiting for you. Grab your controllers, start your engine, and win the race in Racing Fever today!
nodes.short_description: Experience the ultimate VR speedway! Take the wheel in Racing Fever: Car Racing Game, a high-octane racing simulator featuring fully customizable cars, professional tracks, and intense first-person competition. Tune your ride, master the curves, and climb the leaderboard to become the top racer.

nodes.long_description: Khơi dậy niềm đam mê tốc độ! Racing Fever đưa bạn trực tiếp vào ghế lái của những cỗ máy mạnh mẽ. Đặc điểm: Gara tùy chỉnh, nâng cấp hiệu suất, đường đua đa dạng và buồng lái VR sống động.
nodes.short_description: Trải nghiệm tốc độ VR đỉnh cao! Cầm lái trong Racing Fever, trò chơi giả lập đua xe với những chiếc xe tùy biến, đường đua chuyên nghiệp và sự cạnh tranh gay gắt.

nodes.long_description: Hız tutkunuzu ateşleyin! Racing Fever sizi güçlü yarış makinelerinin sürücü koltuğuna oturtuyor. Özellikler: Özel garaj ve yükseltmeler, performans ayarı, çeşitli pistler ve etkileşimli VR kokpiti.
nodes.short_description: Nihai VR hızını deneyimleyin! Racing Fever: Car Racing Game ile tamamen özelleştirilebilir arabalar ve profesyonel pistlerde direksiyon başına geçin ve en iyi yarışçı olun.

nodes.long_description: Ανάψτε το πάθος σας για ταχύτητα! Το Racing Fever σας βάζει στη θέση του οδηγού. Χαρακτηριστικά: Εξατομικευμένο γκαράζ, αναβαθμίσεις επιδόσεων, ποικίλες πίστες και καθηλωτικό VR κόκπιτ με διαδραστικά χέρια.
nodes.short_description: Ζήστε την απόλυτη ταχύτητα στο VR! Πάρτε το τιμόνι στο Racing Fever, έναν εξομοιωτή με πλήρως προσαρμόσιμα αυτοκίνητα, επαγγελματικές πίστες και έντονο ανταγωνισμό.

nodes.long_description: Tenn din lidenskap for fart! Racing Fever setter deg rett i førersetet. Funksjoner: Tilpasset garasje og oppgraderinger, ytelsestuning, varierte baner og et imponerende VR-cockpit med detaljert interiør.
nodes.short_description: Opplev den ultimative VR-farten! Ta rattet i Racing Fever, en racingsimulator med fullt tilpassbare biler, profesjonelle baner og intens førstepersonskonkurranse.

nodes.long_description: Tænd din passion for fart! Racing Fever sætter dig i førersædet af kraftfulde maskiner. Funktioner: Brugerdefineret garage, performance-tuning, varierede baner og et fordybende VR-cockpit med detaljeret interiør.
nodes.short_description: Oplev den ultimative VR-speedway! Tag rattet i Racing Fever, en racersimulator med fuldt tilpasselige biler, professionelle baner og intens konkurrence i første person.

nodes.long_description: Rozpal swoją pasję do prędkości! Racing Fever stawia Cię w fotelu kierowcy potężnych maszyn. Cechy: Własny garaż i ulepszenia, tuning osiągów, różnorodne tory i imersyjny kokpit VR z interaktywnymi dłońmi.
nodes.short_description: Doświadcz niesamowitej prędkości w VR! Usiądź za kierownicą w Racing Fever, symulatorze z personalizowanymi autami, profesjonalnymi trasami i intensywną rywalizacją.

nodes.long_description: Desperta a tua paixão pela velocidade! Racing Fever coloca-te no lugar do condutor de máquinas poderosas. Características: Garagem personalizada, ajuste de performance, pistas diversas e cockpit VR imersivo com visão detalhada.
nodes.short_description: Vive a derradeira experiência de velocidade em VR! Assume o volante em Racing Fever, um simulador com carros personalizáveis, pistas profissionais e competição intensa.

nodes.short_description: Erleben Sie die ultimative VR-Rennstrecke! Übernehmen Sie das Steuer in Racing Fever, einem Rennsimulator mit anpassbaren Autos, Profi-Strecken und intensiven Wettkämpfen.

nodes.long_description: Ανάψτε το πάθος σας για ταχύτητα! Το Racing Fever σας βάζει στη θέση του οδηγού. Χαρακτηριστικά: Εξατομικευμένο γκαράζ, αναβαθμίσεις επιδόσεων, ποικίλες πίστες και καθηλωτικό VR κόκπιτ με διαδραστικά χέρια.
nodes.short_description: Ζήστε την απόλυτη ταχύτητα στο VR! Πάρτε το τιμόνι στο Racing Fever, έναν εξομοιωτή με πλήρως προσαρμόσιμα αυτοκίνητα, επαγγελματικές πίστες και έντονο ανταγωνισμό.

nodes.long_description: Tenn din lidenskap for fart! Racing Fever setter deg rett i førersetet. Funksjoner: Tilpasset garasje og oppgraderinger, ytelsestuning, varierte baner og et imponerende VR-cockpit med detaljert interiør.
nodes.short_description: Opplev den ultimative VR-farten! Ta rattet i Racing Fever, en racingsimulator med fullt tilpassbare biler, profesjonelle baner og intens førstepersonskonkurranse.

nodes.long_description: Tænd din passion for fart! Racing Fever sætter dig i førersædet af kraftfulde maskiner. Funktioner: Brugerdefineret garage, performance-tuning, varierede baner og et fordybende VR-cockpit med detaljeret interiør.
nodes.short_description: Oplev den ultimative VR-speedway! Tag rattet i Racing Fever, en racersimulator med fuldt tilpasselige biler, professionelle baner og intens konkurrence i første person.

nodes.long_description: Rozpal swoją pasję do prędkości! Racing Fever stawia Cię w fotelu kierowcy potężnych maszyn. Cechy: Własny garaż i ulepszenia, tuning osiągów, różnorodne tory i imersyjny kokpit VR z interaktywnymi dłońmi.
nodes.short_description: Doświadcz niesamowitej prędkości w VR! Usiądź za kierownicą w Racing Fever, symulatorze z personalizowanymi autami, profesjonalnymi trasami i intensywną rywalizacją.

nodes.long_description: Desperta a tua paixão pela velocidade! Racing Fever coloca-te no lugar do condutor de máquinas poderosas. Características: Garagem personalizada, ajuste de performance, pistas diversas e cockpit VR imersivo com visão detalhada.
nodes.short_description: Vive a derradeira experiência de velocidade em VR! Assume o volante em Racing Fever, um simulador com carros personalizáveis, pistas profissionais e competição intensa.

nodes.long_description: Entfachen Sie Ihre Leidenschaft für Geschwindigkeit! Racing Fever versetzt Sie direkt in den Fahrersitz. Features: Eigene Garage & Upgrades, Performance-Tuning, diverse Rennstrecken und ein immersives VR-Cockpit.
nodes.short_description: Erleben Sie die ultimative VR-Rennstrecke! Übernehmen Sie das Steuer in Racing Fever, einem Rennsimulator mit anpassbaren Autos, Profi-Strecken und intensiven Wettkämpfen.

nodes.long_description: Зажгите страсть к скорости! Racing Fever ставит вас на место водителя мощных болидов. Особенности: Тюнинг и кастомизация в гараже, настройка производительности, разнообразные трассы и реалистичный VR-кокпит.
nodes.short_description: Испытайте безумную скорость в VR! Садитесь за руль в Racing Fever — гоночном симуляторе с кастомизацией авто, профессиональными трассами и напряженными заездами.
